newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan ethylene demand to rise in Jan-Jun '97 - MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan ethylene demand to rise in Jan-Jun '97 - MITI.

text.p: Japan's ethylene demand in the first half of 1997 is expected to grow 2.5 percent from the year-ago period to 3.55 million tonnes, aided by gradual growth in the domestic economy, the Trade Ministry said on Thursday.
Ethylene demand for domestic consumption in the January to June period is seen growing 1.7 percent to 3.03 million tonnes.
Export demand is also seen remaining firm, in spite of increasing ethylene production capacity in other Asian countries, the ministry said.
In the second half of 1996, Japan's ethylene demand for domestic use and exports is forecast to grow 6.2 percent from the same period a year earlier to 3.63 million tonnes, it said.

Domestic consumption in July through December this year is seen rising 6.1 percent from a year earlier to 3.17 million tonnes, helped by increased demand from the automobile industry and greater demand for film, it said.

Ethylene exports are seen rising due to healthy demand from Asian countries and the weaker yen against the dollar, which makes Japanese exports more competitive, it said. --Tokyo Energy Desk +81-3-5473-3708
